extracted.intended_audience: print and online publishers, journalists, media organisations, and members of the public in Australia (including potential complainants)
extracted.subtask_description: High-level overview of the Australian Press Council's standards, principles, complaints handling and policy materials for print and online publishers and the public. The page lists the Council's roles, statements of principles, specific standards, advisory guidelines, complaint procedures and related publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Council responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The council is responsible for promoting high standards of media practice, community access to information of public interest, and freedom of expression through the media

rubrics_metrics.name: Statements of Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: The Council's Statements of Principles are binding on all publications which are subject to its jurisdiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of General Principles / Standards of Practice
rubrics_metrics.description: The Press Council's Statement of General Principles forms part of its Standards of Practice which are binding on all print and online publishers that are members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Standards (part of the Council's Standards of Practice) that apply to publishers under the Council's jurisdiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advisory Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Advisory Guidelines (forming part of the Standards of Practice) provided by the Council to guide publishers' conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complaints — information for complainants
rubrics_metrics.description: Information for complainants covering what can be complained about, who can complain and how to make a complaint.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of complaints
rubrics_metrics.description: Council processes for investigation, mediation and adjudication

rubrics_metrics.name: Make a complaint (practical instruction)
rubrics_metrics.description: The fastest way is using our online complaints form here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical route to submit a complaint (link to online form).

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy — statements and submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Australian Press Council makes statements and submissions on a range of public policy issues within its areas of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: A Charter For a Free Press Australia
rubrics_metrics.description: The Australian Press Council encourages other organisations to adopt its Charter for a Free Press.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other materials and publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Other materials including media comment, research reports, issues papers and summaries of Round Tables or other consultations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who we are / membership
rubrics_metrics.description: The Australian Press Council consists of an independent Chair, members, publisher members and their constituent bodies, the MEAA and a Secretariat.
